title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science, STEM field, or equivalent.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or C#; strong background in data structures and algorithms.
description: Join Microsoft as a Software Engineering Intern to design, develop, and test scalable cloud services, web applications, and system software impacting millions worldwide.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from over 160 eligible countries worldwide.
salary: Fully funded (Tuition, monthly living stipend, airfare, health coverage)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent, strong academic record, English language proficiency.
description: Enables international graduate students and young professionals to pursue Master's or PhD degrees and conduct research in the United States.

title: Associate Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Open to early-career developers globally with strong web development foundation.
qualification: Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Vue.js or React, and version control with Git.
description: Contribute to GitLab's open-core DevOps platform by building intuitive user interfaces in an all-remote, asynchronous team environment.

title: Junior Business Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or young professionals with 0-2 years of business analyst experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or quantitative discipline.
description: Work directly with client teams to gather and analyze data, formulate strategic solutions, and execute high-impact business transformations.

title: Google Summer of Code 2025
eligibility: Students and open-source beginners aged 18 and older globally.
qualification: Basic programming skills and passion for open-source software development.
description: A global program that pairs new open-source contributors with mentors from participating open-source organizations for a 12+ week programming project.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide interested in learning computer science fundamentals.
salary: Free learning (Optional paid verified certificate available)
description: Harvard University's flagship introductory computer science course covering computational thinking, algorithms, C, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
